other_failure_modes.description: Group-level statistics (e.g., mean) are computed on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the feature distribution of the test set into the training data.

summary: The agent implements a solid baseline using XGBoost with StratifiedKFold and good feature engineering. However, it introduces data leakage by computing group-level aggregations on the combined train/test dataset before splitting. Additionally, it relies heavily on XGBoost's native missing value handling without a comprehensive cleaning strategy and reports only a single evaluation metric.
